spec.purpose: Ühise koostaja tehniline kooskasutuse katse: Amp/Cab, Drive, Delay, Reverb, Compressor, Chorus, Phaser, Wah ja Pitch ühes failis. Pitchiga aluse nihkunud plokiasukohtade kontroll; kuulamisega kinnitatud Bonamassa preset jääb eraldi alles.

cab.policy: Entire captured channel including both slots and microphone/mix/filter settings; not universal factory defaults

hardware: New composition pending device import/export; base and component specimens have separate evidence.
limitations: Only listed SHA-pinned bases; no routing or block insertion
Flanger/Tremolo/Rotary/Pitch availability follows the selected base; no automatic replacement
Amp/Cab templates target B only; Amp B scalar ranges preserved
Drive scalar overrides retain measured type/channel/value combinations
Delay A scalar overrides only type14; Reverb A only type2; Rotary A only measured points
Scene controls retain the previously implemented fields; all other scene assignments are preserved
Shared channel changes affect every scene using that channel
No new output boost, modifier/expression or external IR writing
